components.problem: Iteration-1 significance ceiling was the [simulated] regime. Iteration-2 question: does exact torus spectral KRR on REAL NOAA PSL Kaplan SST v2 monthly anomaly fields (1856-2023, 36x72 5-deg grid, 2005 months; Nino3.4 index validated vs 1982/83, 1997/98, 2015/16 El Nino and 1988/89 La Nina) (a) reconstruct masked real fields with calibrated diagnostic intervals and (b) forecast the real Nino3.4 index at horizons h in {1,3,6,12} against persistence/climatology/AR(1), under a future-blind temporal holdout with leakage verification? EXPECTED-RESULTS CEILING (stated, retained): no SOTA-ENSO-skill claim; no FFT-kernel/spectral-regression newness claim. PRE-REGISTERED HYPOTHESIS-SUPPORT SEMANTICS: the hypothesis counts as SUPPORTED for horizon h if (i) the spectral transfer beats persistence AND train-only climatology AND train-only AR(1) in RMSE AND skill score, AND (ii) the skill margin vs the best baseline exceeds the year-block bootstrap 95% CI (point estimates alone never count); REFUTED if any h fails (i) on more than half the horizons; INDETERMINATE otherwise -- stated before execution, no post-hoc reinterpretation.
components.method: (1) Core: exact torus spectral KRR (BCCB closed-form solve; spectral floor disclosed; exactness verified vs dense floored reference; free-boundary gap measured; masked-input PCG with exact free-boundary BTTB matvec). (2) ONE consistent spectral functional operator: box mean = spectral inner product with the box indicator (Parseval/linearity); identical operator for reconstruction functional and forecast index; commutes with FFT machinery. (3) Transfer forecast (extension, honestly scoped): per-Fourier-mode ridge H_h on train-only modes; index forecast = spectral functional of the transfer-filtered spectrum. (4) CONTROL ARM (isolates the circulant/FFT contribution): non-spectral exact KRR reference (Cholesky on a subsampled grid, n in {2k,5k}, sklearn) on the SAME real data -- reported as accuracy-per-flop and accuracy-per-byte ratios (spectral vs Cholesky), plus wall-clock ratio. (5) LEAK CONTROL normative + VERIFIED: all fits train-only (<= 2015-12); rolling-origin evaluation; circulant wrap SPATIAL-ONLY (no temporal seam crossing); masked cells never in training or error/coverage evaluation; 2015/16 El Nino PEAK (Dec 2015) acknowledged INSIDE train, decay phase test-side.
components.experiment_design: DATA PINNED: NOAA PSL Kaplan SST v2 'sst.mon.anom.nc' (SST v2 monthly anomaly, netCDF-3-origin converted Sep 2014 per file history attr); read via h5py; canonical arrays results/raw/real/fields.npy + index.npy + meta.json (2005 months x 36 x 72, lat -87.5..87.5 step 5, lon 2.5..357.5 step 5; Nino3.4 box rows 17-18, cols 38-47). SEED/RANDOMNESS: rng seeds recorded per arm in artifact metadata; no data-dependent seed choice. REPRODUCIBILITY: per-arm wall_clock_s (median of 3 after warm-up), peak_rss_gb, estimated_flops, estimated_bytes written to every artifact. SPLITS: train 1856-01..2015-12 (1920 months), test 2016-01..2022-12 (84 months); 2023-01 excluded from both (2004 = 2005 - 1); temporal-block CV inside train; mask ratio fixed+mirrored, ocean-only, defined once, same schedule in CV; masked cells excluded from training (evaluation targets only). ARMS: P0 pilot exactness gate (prerequisite; real fields); T1a masked reconstruction (random 10/30/50% + halo w1/2/4 cells, LOFO months; RMSE + skill vs train-only monthly climatology on held-out cells only; CONFORMAL under non-exchangeability: conformity score = absolute residual per held-out cell, calibration pooled OVER CALENDAR-MONTH BLOCKS within the 5 terminal in-train years (seasonal-residual alignment, not split-conformal exchangeability), threshold REFIT per rolling origin, calibration blocks strictly after and non-overlapping with H_h training blocks; coverage DIAGNOSTIC per mask spatially + per fold temporally, mean width; coverage ALSO reported SEPARATELY for the seam-leakage subset (2016-2017) and the decay-phase subset (2016) with explicit tolerance band 0.90 +- 0.06 target); T1b masked-input exact free-boundary PCG matvec (10/30/50%; RMSE on masked cells; residual-vs-tolerance exactness criterion; PCG FAILURE-MODE PLAN: if residual norm stalls above 10x tolerance on real masked grids, raise tolerance and mark the arm 'converged-at-relaxed-tol' in the artifact, never silently drop); T2 functional index regression (spectral box functional, temporal-block CV, vs zero-model = train box mean and direct RBF head); T3 forecast h in {1,3,6,12} ONLY (spectral transfer vs persistence, train-only monthly climatology, train-only AR(1); per-h RMSE/MAE/corr + climatology skill; win rule per pre-registered semantics above; year-block bootstrap PRIMARY significance, Diebold-Mariano secondary; rolling origin; NUMERIC SEAM CHECKS: (i) Dec-Jan block boundaries -- report skill for test origins whose first forecast month is January vs other months; (ii) training-fold truncation -- h=1 skill with train cutoff 2014-12, 2013-12, 2012-12 (discard 1-3 trailing years, skill-change curve); (iii) 2015-excluded vs 2015-retained contrast fixed test window); B sklearn exact-subsample (2k/5k/10k)/Nystrom/RFF (500/2k/5k/10k) on real pooled cells; CONTROL Cholesky exact (2k/5k) as the non-spectral reference (see method 4); S scaling (32x32/72x36/144x72 + extrapolation vs 7 GB), with a transfer note: simulated-torus scaling (sub-ms to 10,368 cells, ~42 MB at 0.25-deg extrapolation) transfers to the real masked domain with the same per-field FFT cost (masks affect training iteration count, not the O(N log N) scale). REAL-DATA THREATS acknowledged in artifacts: Kaplan v2 is reconstruction-smoothed (not reanalysis-informed raw obs); land/coast cells handled by ocean-only masks; missing-value patterns per month recorded and reported. BUDGET worst-case total < 90 s CPU (P0 0.5 / T1a 2 / T1b 10 / T2 3 / T3 1+seam/numeric-sweeps 5 / B 60 / control 8 / S 1 / load 2 s), peak RSS << 7 GB; wall-clock protocol as above; budget claim uses max estimates. GRID-RESOLUTION NOTE: results are scoped to the 5-deg Kaplan grid; 1-deg extensions and the ENSO predictability floor at long horizons are discussion points, not claims. All artifacts carry dataset.origin=real-kaplan-sst-v2 and simulation_marker null.
components.honest_framing: No FFT-kernel/spectral-regression/SOTA-ENSO newness claims. Novelty (now made operational by the revision): the INTEGRATED LEAKAGE-VERIFIED FUTURE-BLIND EVALUATION PROTOCOL for exact spectral kernel methods on real climate grids -- calendar-month conformal diagnostics, numeric seam-leakage checks (Dec-Jan boundaries, truncation sweep, 1-3 trailing-year discard), year-block bootstrap win rules, Cholesky control for accuracy-per-flop isolation, and full data/seed/resource pinning; the FFT machinery itself is a disclosed, benchmarked implementation of textbook circulant/Toeplitz structure exploitation.
